name: net_config_out_of_bounds
description: A MATCH_CONFIG that puts a seat on a team the mode does not have (team 7 in classic), or gives a seat flags no version knows, fails the link with the reason, as an out-of-range your_seat does: the client never half-builds a simulation from it (review M1 protocol 2: team 7 raised an out-of-bounds SCRIPT ERROR in SimMatch.add_seat and the client went on into LOADING).

steps.msg: a seat on team 7 of a one-team mode fails both links

steps.assert: scene.client(1).error_text == 'MATCH_CONFIG puts a seat on team 7, outside the mode'

steps.msg: and no simulation was built from it

steps.assert: scene.client(1).phase_name() == 'FAILED' and scene.client(1).error_text == 'MATCH_CONFIG gives a seat flags this game does not know' and scene.client(1).sim == null
steps.msg: unknown seat flags fail the link too
a known flag is taken: both seats start caretaken (SimTypes.SEAT_CARETAKER, 3)
